questions.evidence: Retrieval practice means bringing information to mind without looking at the source.
questions.explanation: Try to retrieve an answer before checking the notes.

parts.prompt: _____ practice means bringing information to mind without looking.

questions.evidence: Spacing distributes practice across separate study periods.
questions.explanation: Separate sessions provide spaced opportunities to retrieve the material.

options.b: Do every review in one sitting

questions.evidence: Feedback identifies mistakes so the learner can correct them.
questions.explanation: Checking an attempted answer helps identify and correct errors.

parts.prompt: What helps identify mistakes after an attempt?

questions.evidence: Interleaving mixes different kinds of problems within a practice session.
questions.explanation: Interleaving asks you to select a method as well as apply it.

questions.prompt: Connect a new idea to prior knowledge.
questions.evidence: Elaboration connects new information to what the learner already knows.
questions.explanation: Explaining a connection is a way to elaborate.

parts.prompt: What is connecting new information to prior knowledge called?

questions.evidence: Self-explanation describes why a solution step makes sense.
questions.explanation: A useful self-explanation includes the reason behind the step.

parts.prompt: Which is an example of self-explanation?

options.a: Explaining why a solution step works

questions.prompt: Protect attention during a short session.
questions.evidence: Silencing optional notifications reduces interruptions during focus time.
questions.explanation: Reducing optional notifications removes one source of interruption.

questions.evidence: A planned break separates focus blocks and allows a pause before returning.
questions.explanation: A break is a deliberate pause between focus periods.

options.a: A deliberate pause between focus blocks
options.b: A requirement to stop studying forever

questions.evidence: Missed concepts are useful targets for the next focused review.
questions.explanation: Use the mistakes to choose what to revisit.

parts.prompt: Which concepts deserve attention in the next review?

questions.prompt: Interpret a perfect quiz result carefully.
questions.evidence: A quiz samples understanding; a perfect score does not prove complete mastery of every concept.
questions.explanation: A perfect result describes this attempt. Other concepts and later recall may still need practice.

parts.prompt: A perfect score proves complete mastery of every concept: true or false?
